title: Accounts
notes: Rebuilt on ListPage archetype. Honest Suppliers-view framing: inline Alert banner states plainly this is a filtered view of Suppliers; row click/View/Edit route to /suppliers/:id and /suppliers/:id/edit (no fake /accounts/:id); sidebar entry now reads 'Accounts (Suppliers view)' nested in Operations next to Suppliers. Reads/writes exclusively through suppliersApi. FilterBar (search + category select), useInfiniteScroll via ListPage, hover row actions (Eye/Pencil/Phone/Mail/Trash2), bulk delete, skeleton + empty state, and SendMessageDialog for outbound email all present. detailDrawer/relationCombobox not applicable — clicking a row deliberately navigates to the real Supplier detail page rather than opening an in-page drawer, per the owner decision to avoid a fake accounts entity. Export is a client-side themed CSV covering the full filtered dataset (paginates suppliersApi.list to completion) since there is no exportsApi.suppliers endpoint. relationCombobox/phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput/datePicker/urlPrefill are not applicable — this slice has no form page (accounts has no create/edit form of its own; supplier forms are out of scope).
showcaseScript: Open Accounts from the sidebar and note it is a Suppliers view
Filter by category to narrow the corporate accounts
Open a row and land on the full Supplier detail
